summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the methodology for tracking and displaying Ingress/Egress traffic data at an intersection. Currently, all traffic passing through the intersection is counted as a single 'Ingress' count.

A key requirement was raised to separate the traffic counts from different streets (e.g., Suur-Ameerika Street and Endla Street) rather than summing them together.

It was noted that separating this data requires advanced tracking based on the direction of movement of detected points, which is not currently possible in the existing version. Suggestions included attempting to shift sensor zones or re-evaluating video footage to better determine vehicle directionality.
decisions: The current system counts all intersection traffic as a single Ingress count.
action_items: Attempt to adjust or shift the sensor zone to capture directional movement data for vehicles crossing the intersection.
